observations: body L1-L11: the end of the note c) on p. 13; the addendum of Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXII) to pp. 162-163, on Vettius Valens and Julianus of Laodicea, is recorded on p. 162.
body L3-L6: the kappas of «καταβαθμός» are printed in the curly form (ϰ), the thetas of «καταβαθμός» and «ἀναβαθμός» in the open form (ϑ).
body L7: of the long dash of «al–Battānī» only its middle printed (1.4 pt), in the middle of the space of a long dash between al and Battānī.
body L12: the head of the notes on chapter 5, «Ad» and «caput» in small capitals.
body L17, L19, L21, L24: the formulas stand in the middle of the line; α is italic, δ and ε upright; the minus signs of L17 are printed as long dashes and set as minus signs.

body L24: the sines of these formulas are lengths in the circle of radius R, so that the rule of L21 is sin α = R tan δ cot ε; with tangents and cotangents of the same radius R, as in Ḥabash's tables of radius 60, it reads sin α = tg δ cotg ε / R. The printed form holds when tg and cotg are the ratios of sine and cosine; kept as printed.
body L27: the opening bracket before «Calculo» is printed heavy, its upper arm short.

body L30-L39: the figure stands at the left of lines 30 to 39, which are set beside it in a narrow measure. It is redrawn from measurements of the print: the horizon FENO as a circle, the meridian PN as its vertical diameter with the zenith Z marked by a dot on it, and the equator EMO, the ecliptic F♈C and the solstitial colure PRC as arcs of circles fitted to the printed strokes (the equator and the ecliptic end on the horizon at both ends, the colure at its upper end and on the meridian at P). The letters are bold italic; the F is printed blotted; a full stop stands under the bowl of the P and is kept.

body L26-L39: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXII) add to the note b) on pp. 163-164 further tables of right ascensions counted from the beginning of Capricorn; the addendum is recorded on p. 164, where the note ends.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
